notes.title: Mac OS X version released!
notes.notes:
Got Mac OS X and want to enter the world of Catacombs? Now you can with our new Mac version!

Catacombs 1: Demon War is now available with native Mac OS X support on Steam now. Let me know if there any issues on the forums.

Thanks and enjoy!
Derek

notes.title: Version 1.04 released!
notes.notes:
This 1.04 revision alters and tweaks some of the game based on player input. The goal was to make it slightly tougher than before.

- Changed the 'Rage Slash' attack so that it now costs 2 Mana and 2 Life points per use, instead of the previous 1 Mana and 1 Life. It was deemed to be too powerful.
- Tweaked the chances of finding healing potions after fights down about 15-20%.
- Tweaked the chances of finding overall items down by 5% after combats.
- Tweaked down the amounts of gold after fights by 5-10%.
- Changed the Diabolus spell so that it now costs 5 Mana and 4 Life to use and it now has a 60% chance to kill -- instead of costing 5 Mana and 2 Life, with a 70% chance to kill.
- Fixed 'of the Tundra' weapon suffix so that it now works properly.

Thanks and comments are always welcomed!
Derek
